name: Motoyama (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Motoyama town emblem in pink and white: a pink stylised cherry blossom with white discs.
history: Municipal flag of Motoyama, a town in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Motoyama town emblem — a pink stylised cherry blossom with white discs
